args: Open https://example.com/pricing and tell me what the Pro plan costs
experiments.why: A URL-fetch request with WEB_FETCH available probes whether candidate inference moved with WEB_FETCH joining the weak set.
An empty Stage-1 completion must still be reported as an empty completion.
The same HANDLE_RESPONSE argument object emitted twice back to back must not trigger a retry.
Two different HANDLE_RESPONSE objects back to back must be reported as a malformed tool call.
An explicit agentShouldSpeak null must be kept rather than dropped.
A non-object top-level voiceTurnSignal shadows a valid nested one and must yield null.
A whitespace-only top-level speakerEntityId takes precedence over the nested one and must yield null.

obligations.statement: getStage1RetryReason returns null for a HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call whose arguments are the same JSON object emitted twice back to back, such as '{"replyText":"hi"}{"replyText":"hi"}'.

source.quote: still parses normal single-object HANDLE_RESPONSE args

obligations.statement: getStage1RetryReason returns null for a HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call whose arguments are a single JSON object such as '{"replyText":"hi"}'.

getStage1RetryReason returns 'malformed HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call' when a HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call's arguments are two different JSON objects back to back, such as '{"replyText":"hi"}{"replyText":"bye"}'.

getStage1RetryReason returns 'malformed HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call' when HANDLE_RESPONSE tool-call arguments are not a JSON object, such as '["not","an","object"]', '"not an object"' or 'model said {"replyText":"hi"}'.
getVoiceTurnSignalMetadata returns { nextSpeaker: 'user' } for a message whose content has a top-level voiceTurnSignal { nextSpeaker: 'user' }.
getVoiceTurnSignalMetadata returns { agentShouldSpeak: false } for a message whose voiceTurnSignal { agentShouldSpeak: false } is nested under content.metadata.

source.quote: returns null when absent or non-object

obligations.statement: getVoiceTurnSignalMetadata returns null when the content has no voiceTurnSignal or its voiceTurnSignal is not an object, such as the string 'nope'.

source.quote: drops invalid fields and returns null when nothing valid remains

obligations.statement: getVoiceTurnSignalMetadata drops invalid fields and returns null when none remain, for example for voiceTurnSignal { nextSpeaker: 'sideways' }.
getVoiceTurnSignalMetadata keeps an explicit agentShouldSpeak: null, returning { agentShouldSpeak: null } for voiceTurnSignal { agentShouldSpeak: null }.
getVoiceSpeakerEntityId returns the trimmed top-level content.speakerEntityId, 'ent-1' for '  ent-1  '.
getVoiceSpeakerEntityId returns the speakerEntityId nested under content.metadata, 'ent-2' for { metadata: { speakerEntityId: 'ent-2' } }.

source.quote: returns null when absent or blank

obligations.statement: getVoiceSpeakerEntityId returns null when the content has no speakerEntityId or it is blank (whitespace only).
